description: This file defines the Activity model class for the Account module in the OpenCart e-commerce system. It provides methods to add new customer activity records and delete existing activities from the database.

classes.name: Activity
classes.description: Model class for handling customer activity records, including adding new activities and deleting past activities.

methods.name: addActivity
methods.description: Creates a new activity record in the database for a specified customer with a given key and data.

methods.name: deleteActivities
methods.description: Deletes all activity records associated with a specific customer ID.
